As Merck & Co (MRK) Stock Price Rose, Riverpoint Capital Management Has Raised Its Holding; As Amgen (AMGN) Stock Declined, Holder Albion Financial Group Has Upped Its Holding
June 14, 2018 - By Winifred Garcia
Albion Financial Group increased its stake in Amgen Inc. (AMGN) by 251.43% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Albion Financial Group bought 6,575 shares as the company’s stock declined 5.44% with the market. The institutional investor held 9,190 shares of the biological products (no diagnostic substances) company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $1.57M, up from 2,615 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Albion Financial Group who had been investing in Amgen Inc. for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $122.67B market cap company. The stock increased 0.93% or $1.701 during the last trading session, reaching $185.381. About 394,813 shares traded. Amgen Inc. (NASDAQ:AMGN) has risen 14.68% since June 14, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 2.11% the S&P500. Riverpoint Capital Management Llc increased its stake in Merck & Co Inc (MRK) by 5.18% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Riverpoint Capital Management Llc bought 19,227 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.40% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 390,494 shares of the health care company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $21.27 million, up from 371,267 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Riverpoint Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Merck & Co Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $166.60 billion market cap company.
